Indus Seal Reader

Type a CISI number (M-14, H-1827, L-161) or a sign sequence (817 2 48 740). Reading order is right-to-left on the seal impression; sequences here are given in reading order, first sign first.
What it does: parses the inscription into the slots the corpus statistics support (opener, connective, core, title, ending, numerals), shows the Mahadevan sign shapes, says what kind of document it is, and looks the identity up across 5,369 objects. It does not translate — nothing in the corpus can.
